name: Heretic Legions
mercenaries: goetic_warlock (4 Glory; Knights of Avarice: up to 2, first 110 ducats)
scripture_guardian (7 Glory + its melee weapons in ducats)

specialRules.name: No special rules
specialRules.text: A standard Heretic Legions warband has no faction special rules. Fallen alignment; may hire Fallen Mercenaries (Goetic Warlock, Sin Eater, Scripture Guardian).

abilities.name: Puppet Master ACTION
abilities.text: Risky roll (Failure ends Activation). On a Success/Crit, move one other model (friend or foe) within 12" and in LoS up to D6" in a straight line in any direction; may bring it into melee, retreat, climb or jump, but it never counts as charging.

models.name: Death Commando
models.kitRule: Heretic Legions Armoury, but its only Ranged Weapons can be Silenced Pistols (or Tormentor Chains, a campaign Glory Item) and its only Grenades Gas Grenades; other types unrestricted.

abilities.name: Stealth Generator
abilities.text: Ranged Attacks targeting this model suffer -1 DICE.

abilities.name: Hide ACTION
abilities.text: If touching terrain at least 1/2" tall: Risky roll with +1 DICE (Failure ends Activation). On a Success the model cannot be targeted by Ranged Attacks or charges until it moves, charges, retreats, shoots, or an enemy comes within 1.5". BLAST weapons can still catch it.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.text: May deploy using the INFILTRATOR keyword.

abilities.name: Unholy Hymns
abilities.text: Enemy models within 8" of one or more Choristers suffer -1 DICE on all their Success Rolls.

upgrades.name: Heretic Legionnaire
upgrades.text: Upgrade to a Legionnaire: raise either Ranged or Melee from +0 to +1 DICE. You may never have more Legionnaires than un-upgraded Heretic Troopers.

models.name: War Wolf Assault Beast
models.kitRule: none: only its Chainsaw Mouth and Shredding Claws

abilities.name: Assault Beast
abilities.text: Each Melee Attack may use either weapon, or both in sequence (Mouth first, then Claws with the off-hand modifier). Both are RISKY, so a failed roll with either ends the Activation.

abilities.name: Loping Dash
abilities.text: +1 DICE to its Risky roll when taking a Dash ACTION.

models.name: Wretched
models.kitRule: Heretic Legions Armoury items costing up to 10 ducats each; must carry at least 1 Weapon.

abilities.name: Chattel
abilities.text: Campaign only: can be sold for 25 ducats plus half its kit value.

abilities.name: Dark Blessing
abilities.text: When taken Out of Action, place 1 BLESSING MARKER on the nearest friendly ELITE HERETIC model (your choice if tied).

abilities.name: Law of Hell
abilities.text: If its attack takes an enemy ELITE Out of Action, the Wretched is freed: remove it from the game and the roster; it no longer counts for Morale.

models.name: Anointed Heavy Infantry
models.kitRule: always Reinforced Armour + Infernal Brand (included, armour already in profile); otherwise any Heretic Legions Armoury kit.

models.name: Artillery Witch
models.kitRule: always Infernal Bombs; may take Heretic Legions kit except Ranged Weapons and Grenades.

abilities.name: Abiotic Life
abilities.text: -1 INJURY DICE on Injury Rolls against it from GAS attacks.

abilities.name: Artillery Witch Battery
abilities.text: 0-2 Witches allowed only if all other models and kit total 1,000 ducats or more (so 0-1 in a 900-ducat game).

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.text: No Risky roll to Climb or Jump and no Injury Roll for Falling.

uniqueKit.name: Blasphemous Staff
uniqueKit.text: Evil Power: the bearer gets +1 DICE on Success and Risky Success Rolls other than Ranged/Melee attack rolls and Dash rolls (e.g. Puppet Master, Hide).

uniqueKit.name: Tartarus Claws
uniqueKit.text: Harrowing Assault: if a Claws attack takes the target Down or Out of Action, the wielder may move up to 3"; if that brings it within 1" of another enemy it may make another Fight ACTION. No further 3" move if that second attack also downs/kills.

uniqueKit.name: Chainsaw Mouth
uniqueKit.text: War Wolf natural weapon; cannot be removed.

uniqueKit.name: Shredding Claws
uniqueKit.text: War Wolf natural weapon; used as the off-hand second attack.

uniqueKit.name: Infernal Bomb
uniqueKit.text: Artillery Witch only. Duck: -1 INJURY DICE for a model touching terrain at least 1/2" tall between it and the target point. Infernal Strike: if the attack roll succeeds (or a miss scatters onto a base) the Injury Roll for that model counts as DEADLY; others in the blast roll normally. Mighty Explosion: any model hit but not taken Out of Action is blown D3" straight away (target: away from the Witch; blast: away from the target point), stopping at models, Impassable terrain or terrain needing a Climb.

variants.name: Trench Ghosts
variants.changes: Undead Heretics: no ARTIFICIAL models (no War Wolf or Artillery Witch), no Mercenaries, no Hellbound Soul Contracts or Infernal Brands; may swap the Chorister for a Barbed Wire Banshee; everyone gains FEAR, NEGATE DIFFICULT TERRAIN and NEGATE GAS, shrugs off shooting, but dashes slowly; adds Sarcophagus Mines and the Tank Palanquin.

specialRules.name: Barbed Wire Banshee
specialRules.text: May take a Barbed Wire Banshee in place of the Chorister: same profile and cost, but grants +1 INJURY DICE against enemies within 8" instead of Unholy Hymns.

specialRules.name: Enemies of All
specialRules.text: Cannot include Mercenaries.

specialRules.name: Lost Souls
specialRules.text: No ARTIFICIAL models, no Hellbound Soul Contracts or Infernal Brands. Anointed Heavy Infantry lose their Infernal Brand but still cost 95.

specialRules.name: Semi-corporeal
specialRules.text: Injury Rolls caused by Ranged Attacks against models in this warband suffer -1 INJURY DICE.

specialRules.name: Slow and Creeping
specialRules.text: Models count as 3"/Infantry when Dashing, and suffer -1 DICE when attacking an enemy that is Retreating from them.

specialRules.name: Undead Horror
specialRules.text: All models gain FEAR, NEGATE DIFFICULT TERRAIN and NEGATE GAS.

models.name: Barbed Wire Banshee
models.kitRule: any (Trench Ghost armoury). Taken instead of a Chorister (0-1 total between them).

abilities.name: Barbed Wire Shriek
abilities.text: Replaces Unholy Hymns: Injury Rolls against enemy models within 8" of the Banshee get +1 INJURY DICE.

models.name: Anointed Heavy Infantry
models.kitRule: always Reinforced Armour (in profile); no Infernal Brand but still 95 ducats; otherwise any Trench Ghost-legal kit.

uniqueKit.name: Sarcophagus Mine
uniqueKit.text: Walking Bomb: bearer can have no other kit. Trigger ACTION: Risky roll with +1 DICE; on Success/Crit it detonates (Failure: nothing, retry later). It may also detonate, interrupting, when an enemy ends a move within 3". Detonation: every model (friend or foe) within 3" and in LoS is hit by a SHRAPNEL Ranged Attack, +1 INJURY DICE for those within 1"; the bearer is then taken Out of Action.

uniqueKit.name: Tank Palanquin
uniqueKit.text: Bulky: 50mm base, no Shield, Charge Bonus D3" instead of D6". Death From On High: counts 3" taller for Elevated Position when shooting. Standfast: a Down result is treated as a Minor Hit.

variants.name: Knights of Avarice
variants.changes: Followers of Mammon: no Death Commandos, no FIRE or SHRAPNEL kit, every model other than a Wretched must cost at least 80 ducats with kit, Priest swaps Puppet Master for Price of Greed, Witches throw Gas Bombs, up to 2 Goetic Warlocks (first one 110 ducats), adds Coin Hammers, Golden Calf Altars, Standard of Mammon and Tarnished Armour.

specialRules.name: Corrupt Merchants
specialRules.text: At creation may buy 1 item from the New Antioch Armoury and 1 from the Iron Sultanate Armoury, following their stipulations.

specialRules.name: Gas Bombs
specialRules.text: Artillery Witches carry Gas Bombs instead of Infernal Bombs.

specialRules.name: Goetic Warlocks
specialRules.text: May hire up to 2 Goetic Warlock Mercenaries; the first costs 110 ducats instead of its Glory cost (the second costs the normal 4 Glory).

specialRules.name: Infernal Rivalry
specialRules.text: Cannot include Death Commandos.

specialRules.name: Mammon's Chosen
specialRules.text: No model (except Wretched) may cost less than 80 ducats including its kit.

specialRules.name: Preserve the Loot
specialRules.text: No kit that has, or grants, FIRE or SHRAPNEL. Grenade Launchers allowed, but lose SHRAPNEL and gain -1 INJURY DICE, GAS and IGNORE ARMOUR.

specialRules.name: Price of Greed
specialRules.text: The Heretic Priest has the Price of Greed ACTION instead of Puppet Master.

specialRules.name: Worship Mammon
specialRules.text: Campaign Patron is always Mammon.

abilities.name: Price of Greed ACTION
abilities.text: Replaces Puppet Master. Risky roll (Failure ends Activation). On a Success/Crit, make an Injury Roll against an enemy within 12" and in LoS; +1 INJURY DICE on a Crit, plus +1 INJURY DICE for every -1 INJURY MODIFIER the target has (those modifiers still apply).

sim.injury: Injury Roll; +1 INJURY DICE on Crit and +1 INJURY DICE per -1 INJURY MODIFIER on the target

models.name: Artillery Witch
models.kitRule: always Gas Bombs (replacing Infernal Bombs); may take Knights of Avarice-legal kit except Ranged Weapons and Grenades.

abilities.name: Abiotic Life
abilities.text: -1 INJURY DICE on Injury Rolls against it from GAS attacks.

abilities.name: Artillery Witch Battery
abilities.text: 0-2 Witches allowed only if all other models and kit total 1,000 ducats or more (so 0-1 in a 900-ducat game).

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.text: No Risky roll to Climb or Jump and no Injury Roll for Falling.

uniqueKit.name: Coin Hammer
uniqueKit.text: Rune of Mammon: if its Injury Roll puts 1+ BLOOD MARKERS on the target, place 1 BLESSING MARKER on the wielder.

uniqueKit.name: Golden Calf Altar
uniqueKit.text: Illusions: enemies treat all ground within 3" of the bearer or the deployed altar as Difficult terrain (FLYING too). Place Altar ACTION: deploy it within 1" (1/2" high Impassable piece on 25mm base); lost after the game.

uniqueKit.name: Gas Bombs
uniqueKit.text: Knights of Avarice Artillery Witch only. Choking Gas: a model hit but not taken Out of Action staggers D3" in a straight line (target: direction chosen by the attacker; blast: away from the target point), stopping at models, Impassable terrain or terrain needing a Climb.

uniqueKit.name: Standard of Mammon
uniqueKit.text: Kneel Before Me: Down enemies within 1" cannot stand up. Enemies finishing a charge within 1" of the bearer must pass a Success Roll or be placed Down.

uniqueKit.name: Tarnished Armour
uniqueKit.text: Target of Wrath: an enemy that can see the wearer, is not already in melee, and can reach it without climbing, jumping, diving or crossing Dangerous terrain must choose it as its charge target.

variants.name: Heretic Naval Raiders (old Warbands-book variant)
variants.changes: Legacy variant from the Warbands book, superseded by the standalone Heretic Naval Raiders faction: SMGs cost ducats, faster dashes, no War Wolf, at most 2 Anointed and 1 Witch, up to 3 non-ELITE infiltrators. No preset lists here.

specialRules.name: Close Assault Weapons
specialRules.text: Submachine Guns cost 25 ducats instead of Glory.

specialRules.name: Fast as Lightning
specialRules.text: +1 DICE to Risky rolls for Dash ACTIONS for all models.

specialRules.name: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
specialRules.text: Cannot include a War Wolf.

specialRules.name: Light Troops
specialRules.text: Max 2 Anointed models and max 1 Artillery Witch, regardless of warband value.

specialRules.name: Unseen Advance
specialRules.text: Up to 3 non-ELITE models may gain INFILTRATOR for +10 ducats each.

lists.name: The Hellgate Breach
lists.style: Combined-arms assault: the War Wolf and a flaming Anointed lead the charge, the Death Commando infiltrates, the Chorister's hymns sap the enemy and the Priest flings models where he needs them.

lists.name: Ghosts of Tannenberg
lists.style: Slow, unkillable gunline: a Priest on a Tank Palanquin lobs grenades from on high, Semi-corporeal ghosts soak shooting, and Sarcophagus Mines walk into the enemy line to detonate.

lists.name: The Gilded Tithe
lists.style: Elite and few: a Goetic Warlock and coin-hammer bruisers grind through armour, Price of Greed punishes heavily armoured foes, Gas Bombs and gas launchers flush cover, and the Standard of Mammon pins chargers.

models.label: Mammon's Bailiff
models.note: First Goetic Warlock in a Knights of Avarice warband costs 110 ducats instead of 4 Glory.
